exposure: Primary industry of gross domestic product (GDP)
Rate of delivery in maternal and child health hospital
cohort: The study included all pregnant women in Jiangsu province, China, between 2013 and 2018, whose data were collected from various national and provincial health reporting and surveillance systems.
finding: The maternal mortality ratio in Jiangsu province showed a slight increase after 2016, with this trend associated with increased percentages of multiparous mothers and advanced maternal age, and factors like GDP, delivery hospital type, cesarean section rate, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was identified as one of the significant risk factors associated with the maternal mortality ratio.
